title: 2024 Fort St Legal Studies Trial

groups.stimulus: Bronwyn is charged with a speeding offence. Bronwyn was speeding in order to get to a peaceful protest against the Prime Minister. Bronwyn pleads not guilty to the offence. A magistrate finds Bronwyn guilty of the offence and sentences her to community service.

questions.stem: Continued detention best reflects which of the following purposes of punishment?

options.C: General deterrence
options.D: Retribution

questions.stem: Under New South Wales legislation, at what age are children considered capable of committing a crime?

options.D: Fourteen
